Overview
Explore key capabilities to create a digital twin of your warehouse - a dynamic virtual model of processes and workflows - to enable real-time analysis and intelligent optimization for a resilient supply chain.
Ensure on-time and accurate order fulfillment
Access all your business applications for performing daily tasks through one customizable portal on mobile or desktop.
Streamline inbound, outbound, and internal operations on mobile devices with a modern, intuitive user experience. Boost speed and precision through hands-free technologies such as voice-guided picking and augmented reality.
Utilize purpose-built, user-friendly applications that require minimal training for executing role-specific tasks, such as the pick-by-cart app, which allows for efficient picking of multiple orders with high accuracy.
Plan, monitor, measure, and report warehouse labor activities based on engineered labor standards.
